Install icons from a CDN source

Usage: wayle icons install <SOURCE> <SLUGS>...

Arguments:
  <SOURCE>
          Source name (run 'wayle icons sources' to see available sources)

  <SLUGS>...
          Icon slugs to install (e.g., home settings bell)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
    wayle icons install tabler home settings bell
        -> tb-home-symbolic, tb-settings-symbolic, tb-bell-symbolic

    wayle icons install simple-icons firefox spotify
        -> si-firefox-symbolic, si-spotify-symbolic

Run 'wayle icons sources' to see all available icon sources.
Icons are saved to ~/.local/share/wayle/icons/ as GTK symbolic icons.
